About me

A student who finishes what he starts — real projects, a published paper, and a direction: cybersecurity.

I’m a 2nd-year BCA student at Invertis University, Bareilly, currently in my 3rd semester — studying DBMS, Data Structures with C, MIS, Mathematics and Computer Networks. My first-year score was 78%.

I started with C and Python, and I learn best by finishing things: a password generator with a strength checker, a Tkinter calculator, and an expense tracker that actually saves your data to a file. On the web side I have basic HTML/CSS and I’m learning JavaScript.

My long-term direction is cybersecurity. That’s what my research paper and my project choices point to — I like understanding how systems break, and how to build them so they don’t. Right now I’m looking for an internship (remote or in Bareilly) to turn classroom skills into industry experience.

Project 01 · Python

Password Generator with Strength Checker

A security utility that generates customizable, randomized passwords with user-selected length and character sets, and checks how strong a password really is.

What it does

  • Generates randomized passwords with a length you choose
  • Lets you pick the character sets — lowercase, uppercase, numbers and symbols
  • Strength checker rates passwords from Weak to Very Strong based on length and character variety
